title: Studer solar system
description: Studer Xtender + VarioString via SolarSystemSensor. Series datahub_<metric> from Grafana Cloud (14 days live).

list.name: co2_per_liter
list.label: kg CO2 per liter of diesel

panels.title: Battery voltage
panels.description: Default thresholds are an assumption for a 48 V lead-acid bank (red < 48 V, green >= 50 V). Adjust.

panels.title: Net battery power
panels.description: Battery voltage x (Xtender battery current + VarioString battery current). Positive = charging. Assumes 3005 is negative when discharging; verify at night under load.

panels.title: Consumption
panels.description: AC output power of the Xtender.

panels.title: Generator power
panels.description: AC input power. Only meaningful if the generator feeds the Xtender AC input.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the last battery voltage sample (polling every 300 s). Shows 'no data' after 5 minutes without a sample.

panels.title: Distance to shutdown
panels.description: Battery voltage minus the low voltage disconnect (LVD) of the Xtender: how many volts remain before it shuts off. Thresholds (red < 1 V, green >= 2.5 V) are an assumption; adjust.

panels.title: Shutdown voltage (LVD)
panels.description: Low voltage disconnect configured in the Xtender.

panels.title: Consumption by source

panels.description: Stacked areas show where the current consumption comes from; the stack always sums to the consumption line. Modelled, not measured: generator = AC input (max. consumption); battery = measured discharge power; PV = what PV can cover of the rest; grey = rest that the sources cannot explain (losses, inverter efficiency, sensor error).

panels.title: Battery voltage
panels.description: A falling 24 h minimum from week to week means capacity loss. Sag under load shows in the voltage dips.

panels.title: Net battery power
panels.description: Battery voltage x (Xtender battery current + VarioString battery current). Positive = charging. Assumes 3005 is negative when discharging; verify at night under load.

panels.title: Power balance
panels.description: PV + generator is roughly consumption + battery charging + losses.

panels.title: Battery currents
panels.description: Both are needed for the net battery power: VarioString charges the battery directly.

panels.title: Generator
panels.description: Run time and output of the generator at the AC input.

panels.title: Energy today (kWh)
panels.description: Daily counters of the devices; they reset at midnight.

panels.title: Overloads (per 24 h)
panels.description: Counter increase: shows when the load hits the Xtender limit.

panels.title: States
panels.description: Meaning of the numbers from the Studer appendix V1.6.40. A value that is not listed there is shown in gray as a number.

panels.title: Generator energy
panels.description: Electrical energy that came in through the Xtender AC input during the selected time range (average input power x time).

panels.title: Diesel (estimate)
panels.description: Generator energy / kWh per liter. Estimate: set the variable 'Generator kWh per liter' at the top from real refuelling data.

panels.title: CO2 (estimate)
panels.description: Diesel estimate x kg CO2 per liter (direct emissions of the burned fuel).

panels.title: Generator run time
panels.description: Time with more than 50 W at the AC input (rough, 5 minute resolution).

panels.title: Diesel per day (estimate)
panels.description: Trailing 24 h window per day. Grafana Cloud keeps about 14 days.
